agent_connections_mode_material.name: agent_connections_mode_material
agent_connections_mode_material.value:
("agent_connections"."mode" = 'managed' and "agent_connections"."ciphertext" is null and "agent_connections"."zcp_project_id" is null)
        or ("agent_connections"."mode" = 'api_key' and "agent_connections"."key_version" is not null and "agent_connections"."iv" is not null and "agent_connections"."ciphertext" is not null and "agent_connections"."auth_tag" is not null and "agent_connections"."zcp_project_id" is null)
        or ("agent_connections"."mode" = 'codex_workspace' and "agent_connections"."ciphertext" is null and "agent_connections"."zcp_project_id" is not null and "agent_connections"."zcp_service_id" is not null)

repository_recipes_confirmation_complete.name: repository_recipes_confirmation_complete
repository_recipes_confirmation_complete.value: ("repository_recipes"."status" <> 'confirmed') or ("repository_recipes"."approved_recipe" is not null and "repository_recipes"."fingerprint" is not null and "repository_recipes"."confirmed_by_user_id" is not null and "repository_recipes"."confirmed_at" is not null)
